lessons.keep: Make the agent explain gaps before asking to act.
lessons.avoid: Avoid implying instant causal improvement with a rapidly rising score.
lessons.open: Real action execution, score definition, timing, publication permissions and audio remain unverified.
try: For Tin, ask why a campaign is underperforming and display three evidence-linked causes before approval.
Show one completed outreach or campaign artifact, then a clearly dated performance change instead of an immediate unexplained percentage.

comparison.story: Introduce the visibility problem and reporting burden. → Reveal a conversational alternative. → Connect a plain question to diagnosis and approval. → Claim execution and improvement. → Summarize benefits and invite a trial.
